description: This file defines a class `Task` within the `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Cron` namespace. The class extends a base controller and implements an `index` method that checks for processing tasks and initiates a PHP script execution if none are processing, with platform-specific handling for Windows and Unix-like systems.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing scheduled tasks in the admin section, particularly for starting tasks if none are currently processing.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to check for processing tasks and start the cron task process if none are running.
